Dryer Vent Cleaning That Protects Your Home

The U.S. Fire Administration reports that dryers cause approximately 2,900 house fires annually — and the leading cause is failure to clean the vent. Lint accumulates inside dryer vents over time, restricting airflow and creating a serious fire hazard.


HD Pro Cleaning's professional dryer vent cleaning service thoroughly removes lint, debris, and blockages from the full length of your vent — not just the lint trap. We restore safe, efficient airflow and give you peace of mind.

Our Dryer Vent Cleaning Work

Full-Length Lint Removal

We clean the entire vent run from the dryer to the exterior exhaust cap.

Blockage Clearing

Bird nests, debris, and compacted lint blockages are fully removed.

Exterior Cap Inspection

The exterior vent cap is inspected and cleaned to ensure proper airflow and pest exclusion.

Vent Line Inspection

We inspect the vent line for damage, kinks, or improper materials that restrict airflow.

Flexible Duct Cleaning

Flexible dryer duct sections are cleaned and inspected for compliance with safety codes.

Multi-Unit Building Service

Coordinated dryer vent cleaning programs for apartment complexes and condominiums.

Our Dryer Vent Cleaning Process

A safe, thorough clean from dryer to exterior

🔍

Inspection

We inspect the vent line length, material, and condition before cleaning begins.

💨

Airflow Test

Initial airflow is measured to quantify restriction levels before we start.

🪣

✔️

Post-Clean Test

Benefits of Dryer Vent Cleaning

Fire Safety

Removing lint buildup eliminates the leading cause of dryer fires in residential and commercial buildings.

Faster Drying Times

Restored airflow means clothes dry in one cycle instead of two or three.

Lower Energy Bills

An efficient dryer uses less electricity or gas per cycle, cutting utility costs.

Longer Dryer Life

A dryer that runs efficiently experiences less heat stress and mechanical wear.

Less Wear on Clothes

Reduced heat buildup from restricted vents means less damage to fabrics.

Carbon Monoxide Safety

For gas dryers, a blocked vent can force exhaust gases back into your home — cleaning prevents this.

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should I clean my dryer vent?

The National Fire Protection Association recommends cleaning dryer vents at least once a year.

What are signs my dryer vent needs cleaning?

Clothes taking multiple cycles to dry, the dryer running hot, or a burning smell are all warning signs.

How long does cleaning take?

Most dryer vent cleaning services take 45 minutes to 1.5 hours depending on vent length and blockage.

Do you service apartment buildings?

Yes. We offer coordinated multi-unit dryer vent cleaning programs for building managers.
